title: Bold, italics, and underline
drDigitalIntro:
You can change how your words look to add emphasis.
• Bold makes text stand out and look stronger.
• Italics tilt the text to show titles, quotes, or gentle emphasis.
• Underline draws a line under the text.
• First select your text, then use Ctrl+B for bold, Ctrl+I for italic, Ctrl+U for underline.
• Same pattern: Ctrl (or Command on a Mac) plus the first letter of what you want.

playgroundTask.goal: Use Bold, Italic, and Underline keyboard shortcuts

steps.say: Type a few words in the editor below — anything you like.
Now press Ctrl+A (or Command+A) to select all the text.
Press Ctrl+B (or Command+B) to make the selected text bold.
Press Ctrl+I (or Command+I) to add italics.
Press Ctrl+U (or Command+U) to underline the text.

drDigitalSuccess: Bold, italic and underline, all from the keyboard. The same three shortcuts work in nearly every program that takes typing.
drDigitalHint: Select all your text first with Ctrl+A, then use Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, or Ctrl+U to format it. Look for the glowing button in the toolbar — that is the one to use next.
